propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly without retry wrapper, leaving it outside rebar's self-healing seam unlike all other store write paths
fatal: bad object HEAD during git bundle create indicates the merge commit object was absent from the object database at bundle time, not corrupt or unborn
Transient object-DB read failures are retried by existing wrappers in gitutil for all store paths except s3_doctor, causing the same fault class to be fatal here and harmless elsewhere
The operator error message S3DoctorConflict misdescribes object-DB read failures as heads conflicts and incorrectly directs to rebar fsck-recover
Routing s3_doctor._git through gitutil.run_git_write with scoped bad object marker enables inheritance of per-store advisory lock, bounded retry, and transient-fault recovery without new retry logic
